- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Chhaang is a traditional Nepali alcoholic beverage made from fermented grains like barley, millet, or rice.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Chhaang has a tangy, slightly sour taste and is similar to beer.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Chhaang is often enjoyed during festivals and celebrations, including weddings, and has a high alcohol content ranging from 5-10%.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Sel Roti is a staple in Nepali cuisine and is popular during the festival season of Dashain and Tihar.
